# PR Flywheel — TDD Task List

## Relevant Files

- `orchestrator/__init__.py` - Package init for the orchestrator module
- `orchestrator/models.py` - Data models: LoopState, Issue, TerminationStatus, Finding, DecisionResult
- `orchestrator/severity_classifier.py` - SEV_ORDER scale, severity comparison helpers, severity-floor filtering
- `orchestrator/review_swarm.py` - Parallel reviewer dispatch with ThreadPoolExecutor, timeout, structured findings, shared prompt-loading logic
- `orchestrator/signal_aggregator.py` - Normalize swarm findings + CI checks + human reviews + security alerts into signals.json
- `orchestrator/flywheel_controller.py` - Main control loop: load_state, merge_findings, resolve_issues_from_commit_messages, decide, _write_github_output helper, type-safe dict access, commit-message resolution detection
- `orchestrator/fix_dispatcher.py` - Select fix agent (Claude vs Copilot), build dispatch payload, forbidden-path validation
- `orchestrator/requirements.txt` - Python dependencies (PyGithub)
- `orchestrator/tests/__init__.py` - Test package init
- `orchestrator/tests/test_models.py` - Tests for data models
- `orchestrator/tests/test_severity_classifier.py` - Tests for severity classification and filtering
- `orchestrator/tests/test_review_swarm.py` - Tests for review swarm dispatch, timeout, graceful degradation
- `orchestrator/tests/test_signal_aggregator.py` - Tests for signal normalization and de-duplication (load_swarm_findings, normalize_check_runs, classify_review_comment, normalize_human_review, parse_code_scanning_alerts, parse_unresolved_threads, build_signals with de-duplication and graceful error handling)
- `orchestrator/tests/fixtures/` - Directory for sample test fixtures (created)
- `orchestrator/tests/test_flywheel_controller.py` - Tests for controller logic: load_state, merge_findings, decide
- `orchestrator/tests/test_fix_dispatcher.py` - Tests for fix agent selection, payload building, forbidden-path validation
- `orchestrator/tests/test_integration.py` - End-to-end integration tests for the full six-stage loop lifecycle
- `prompts/reviewers/correctness.md` - Correctness reviewer system prompt template
- `prompts/reviewers/security.md` - Security reviewer system prompt template
- `prompts/REVIEW.md` - Default review doctrine
- `prompts/claude-fix-prompt.md` - Fix agent rules and prompt template
- `prompts/copilot-instructions.md` - Sample per-repo customization doctrine with severity mappings, path exclusions, and review focus guidelines
- `.github/workflows/flywheel.yml` - Reusable workflow (workflow_call) for the PR flywheel
- `.github/workflows/flywheel-nightly.yml` - Babysitter cron for stuck PRs
- `.github/workflow-templates/flywheel-caller.yml` - Org-level consumer caller template
- `.github/workflow-templates/flywheel-caller.properties.json` - Template metadata
- `state/loop-state.json` - Persisted loop state (initial placeholder)
- `orchestrator/tests/fixtures/` - Sample PR, review, check-run, thread, and code-scanning payloads for deterministic tests

### Notes

- **This project follows Test-Driven Development (TDD).** Each parent task that involves code has sub-tasks ordered: write tests → confirm failure (red) → implement (green) → refactor.
- Python tests use `uv run pytest orchestrator/tests/`.
- Use `ruff` for formatting/linting, `pyright` strict mode for type checking.
- All Python commands run through `uv` (e.g., `uv run python`, `uv run pytest`).
- Data models should use `dataclass` or Pydantic `BaseModel` with frozen config — prefer typed models over raw dicts.
- The orchestrator targets Python ≥3.11 with PyGithub as the only external dependency.
- Keep issue IDs deterministic and stable across rounds; many downstream tests should assert exact `issue_id` behavior.
- Test fixtures in `orchestrator/tests/fixtures/` provide sample payloads for deterministic, repeatable tests.

## Verification Criteria

- [ ] All directories exist: `orchestrator/`, `orchestrator/tests/`, `prompts/reviewers/`, `state/`, `.github/workflows/`, `.github/workflow-templates/`.
- [ ] `uv run python -c "import orchestrator"` succeeds without errors.
- [ ] `uv run pytest orchestrator/tests/` passes with 0 failures.
- [ ] `ruff check orchestrator/` produces no errors.
- [ ] `ruff format --check orchestrator/` shows no formatting changes needed.
- [ ] `orchestrator/models.py` defines `TerminationStatus` (4 values), `IssueStatus` (4 values), `Issue` (with `to_dict`/`from_dict`), and `LoopState` (with `to_dict`/`from_dict`).
- [ ] `orchestrator/severity_classifier.py` exports `SEV_ORDER`, `severity_gte`, `severity_lt`, `filter_by_floor`, `classify_severity` — all with type annotations.
- [ ] `orchestrator/review_swarm.py` exports `generate_issue_id`, `run_reviewer`, `dispatch_swarm` with `ThreadPoolExecutor` parallelism and 120-second timeout.
- [ ] `orchestrator/signal_aggregator.py` normalizes swarm findings, CI checks, human/AI reviews, unresolved threads, and code-scanning alerts into a single signals dict.
- [ ] `orchestrator/flywheel_controller.py` implements `load_state`, `merge_findings`, `decide`, and `main()` with argparse, 5-minute poll enforcement, and `GITHUB_OUTPUT` writing.
- [ ] `orchestrator/fix_dispatcher.py` implements `select_agent`, `build_dispatch_payload` (capped at 10 items), `validate_forbidden_paths`, and `get_forbidden_files`.
- [ ] `prompts/reviewers/correctness.md` and `prompts/reviewers/security.md` exist with focused system prompts.
- [ ] `prompts/REVIEW.md` exists with default review doctrine and severity scale.
- [ ] `prompts/claude-fix-prompt.md` exists with all 7 fix-agent rules from the PRD.
- [ ] `.github/workflows/flywheel.yml` is valid YAML with `workflow_call` trigger, all 6 inputs/secrets, concurrency group, draft-PR skip, fork skip, self-trigger skip, and all orchestrator steps.
- [ ] `.github/workflows/flywheel-nightly.yml` exists with daily cron schedule for stuck PRs.
- [ ] `.github/workflow-templates/flywheel-caller.yml` and `flywheel-caller.properties.json` exist.
- [ ] `flywheel:pause` label causes the workflow to exit early (tested via integration test asserting early-exit logic).
- [ ] Integration tests cover all 4 termination states: SUCCESS, HANDOFF, BLOCKED, WAITING.
- [ ] Forbidden-path validation rejects `.github/workflows/**` and `**/secrets/**` patterns.
- [ ] Dispatch payload is capped at 10 items maximum.
- [ ] 5-minute poll interval is enforced — controller returns `waiting` if called too soon.
- [ ] All auto-commit messages include `Co-authored-by` trailer.
- [ ] `pyright` passes on the orchestrator modules in strict mode, confirming all functions have parameter and return types.
